title.narrative: UNIDO-India Country Programme 2018-2022 for Inclusive and Sustainable Industrial Development (ISID)

description.narrative: The present UNIDO-India Country Programme (CP 13-17) will expire in December of 2017. A new Country Programme (CP) for 2018-22 from UNIDO is in the preparatory stages upon the request of the Government of India. A formal letter of request from the Secretary (Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP)) to this effect was received on 26th May 2017. The new Country Programme Framework is expected to: cover key thematic areas including poverty reduction/sustainable livelihoods, skill development and job creation, agro-industry development and inclusive and sustainable industrialization; align with main government initiatives; and reflect expectations of main stakeholders in the Indian industrial ecosystem whilst also building upon lessons learnt from past experiences. The eight results areas foreseen in the UNSDF 2018-2022 are: 1. Poverty and urbanization 2. Good health, water and sanitation 3. Inclusive, quality education and employability 4. Nutrition and food security 5. Natural resources management, community resilience and energy efficiency 6. Skilling, entrepreneurship and job creation 7. Gender equality and youth development 8. India and the United Nations
